title: Growth mindset
examples: Teacher: What is the difference between a growth mindset and a fixed mindset?
Student: Do I really have to try hard to get better at something?
Teacher: Can my brain actually change over time?

explain.say: Today we say how our brains can actually grow stronger.
We say that trying hard helps our brain build new connections.
We say that making mistakes is actually a very important part of learning.
We say that 'yet' is a magic word for believing in yourself.

items: Now: I cannot ride the bike
Later: I will ride the bike

explain.say: For example, if you are learning to tie your shoes, you might tie them wrong.
In real life, learning a new sport takes many tries and falls.

faq.q: What does a growth mindset mean for my schoolwork?
faq.a: It means you believe your brain can get smarter with effort. You can also say this when you feel like giving up.
asks: How do I think about learning?
Does my brain get smarter by trying?

faq.q: Are mistakes bad when I am learning something new?
faq.a: No, mistakes are just clues that show you where you need more practice. They help you learn the right way.
asks: Is it okay to get things wrong?
What should I do when I fail a test?

faq.a: The word 'yet' shows that you are still learning and you can improve. It means you are not finished growing.
asks: Why do I need to say 'yet'?

faq.q: Is being naturally smart enough enough?
faq.a: No, being smart is like a muscle; it gets stronger when you use it. Effort is what makes the brain grow.
asks: Do I have to be born smart?

faq.q: How do I start using a growth mindset today?
faq.a: Start by noticing when you say 'I can't do it.' Then, change it to 'I can't do it yet.'
asks: What is the first step to growing my mind?
Can I practice this every day?

facts: The brain can form new connections through practice.
Mistakes show us exactly what we need to study more.
Saying 'yet' shows you believe in future improvement.
Effort, not just natural ability, builds intelligence.

quiz.say: If you get a math problem wrong, what is the best thing to think?

options.show: I should never try that type of problem again.
options.say: I should never try that type of problem again.

options.show: Mistakes show me exactly what I need to practice more.
options.say: Mistakes show me exactly what I need to practice more.

options.show: It means I am not smart enough.
options.say: It means I am not smart enough.

options.show: I should just copy the answer from my friend.
options.say: I should just copy the answer from my friend.

quiz.why: This is right because mistakes are helpful clues about learning.

wrong.0: This is tempting because it feels safer to avoid difficulty.
wrong.2: This is tempting because it feels like giving up.
wrong.3: This is tempting because it seems like an easy way out.

quiz.say: What does adding the word 'yet' help you remember?

options.show: I should stop trying because I failed.
options.say: I should stop trying because I failed.

options.show: This topic is too hard for me to understand.
options.say: This topic is too hard for me to understand.

options.show: I am still learning and I can improve.
options.say: I am still learning and I can improve.

options.show: I am already perfect at this skill.
options.say: I am already perfect at this skill.

quiz.why: This is right because 'yet' shows your potential for growth.

wrong.0: This is tempting because failure feels very final.
wrong.1: This is tempting because it labels the subject as impossible.
wrong.3: This is tempting because it sounds like a final answer.

quiz.say: To make your brain stronger, what is most important?

options.show: Asking someone else to do it for you.
options.say: Asking someone else to do it for you.

options.show: Putting in effort when things are hard.
options.say: Putting in effort when things are hard.

options.show: Not making any mistakes at all.
options.say: Not making any mistakes at all.

quiz.why: This is right because effort is what builds new brain connections.

wrong.0: This is tempting because it feels like cheating.
wrong.2: This is tempting because it is easy to notice.
wrong.3: This is tempting because mistakes feel scary.
